text:
if u ever fuck ur life up, remember:

“What got you into this mess will get you out."

a wise man hit me with that, almost as a throwaway line

but I still meditate on it and have to pass it along, even though I can't confirm for you that it will hold true

u sort of just know it will...sometimes u arrive at one of those strange, immutable, unyielding laws of the universe.

duality in all things + "your greatest weakness is your greatest strength taken too far" + La Rochefoucauld's maxim #1:

"Our virtues are most frequently but vices disguised."

quotedTweet.text: "Those who escape hell never really talk about it and nothing much bothers them after that.” Bukowski
